##### Project general facts

Sereno Residences offer a lifestyle defined by tranquility, simplicity, and a deep connection to the beauty of everyday living. Designed to elevate your living experience, Sereno provides a haven away from the city's fast pace, allowing residents to embrace a more mindful, balanced way of life. These thoughtfully designed residences feature contemporary aesthetics and modern comforts, with floor-to-ceiling windows that flood each home with natural light, creating a sanctuary where spacious rooms combine style and functionality.

Sereno features a range of amenities that cater to different lifestyles, whether you're looking to relax or stay active. The lush garden and swimming pool offer serene communal spaces perfect for unwinding, while nearby retail outlets provide everyday convenience at your doorstep. Whether you're taking a quiet stroll, enjoying a refreshing swim, or gathering with friends and family, Sereno's spaces are designed to adapt to your pace of life and give you the freedom to live on your own terms.

Every residence at Sereno features high-quality finishes, including premium porcelain tile flooring throughout enhanced by a bespoke pattern and veneer doors. Kitchens are fitted with quartz countertops and modern laminate cabinets, complemented by German appliances. Bathrooms feature sanitaryware from top brands such as Duravit or Geberit, with ceramic wall tiles and quartz or granite vanity countertops, along with elegant veneer shelving. The semi-furnished apartments with custom-made laminate wardrobes offer a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and contemporary living.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, a community in the heart of Dubai known for its peaceful and welcoming environment, this exceptional location is strategically positioned between Al Khail Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, offering easy access to key areas such as Dubai Marina, JLT, and Downtown Dubai. The district features a mix of villas, townhouses, and apartment complexes, catering to both families and professionals seeking quality living spaces.

The location is distinguished by its well-planned layout with a strong emphasis on community living, dotted with lush parks, children's play areas, and sports facilities that encourage an active and healthy lifestyle. A growing number of local amenities, including supermarkets, cafes, and schools, make it a self-sufficient neighborhood. The blend of contemporary and Mediterranean designs creates a visually appealing environment with a focus on green spaces and walkable streets.

For those seeking a residence that embodies tranquility, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of peaceful surroundings, community-focused amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can embrace a more mindful, balanced way of life.
